title: Young Man Senior Portrait, 1963 B&W Photo, Plymouth
description: A studio portrait photograph from June 1963 featuring a young man with a short crew cut, dressed in a dark suit jacket, narrow tie, and crisp white collared shirt. The front lower margin bears the printed caption 'PLYMOUTH, JUNE '63'. The photograph is printed on classic textured linen-finish paper typical of wallet-sized high school senior portraits of the early 1960s.
